title: Avionics temperature through a flight
line: A two-mass thermal model of a board and its case, with ode45.
description: Temperature of an avionics board through a three-hour flight. The board and its case are two thermal masses; the electrical load rises in flight while the cooling air gets thinner and colder with altitude.
thumbnailAlt: Board and case temperatures of an avionics unit over a three-hour flight against the board limit, rendered by RunMat
